instruction: Change the heading font to Times New Roman.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing heading font family to Times New Roman. Similar complexity to original. Verified: original uses Arial font which can be changed.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic mismatch: Instruction says 'Change the heading font' but evaluator checks 'first paragraph' font, not specifically a heading
Getter logic error: get_docx_first_line_font_props__5dd0f660 extracts font from doc.paragraphs[0] (first paragraph) without verifying it's actually a heading
Incomplete verification: The first paragraph might not be a heading - headings in DOCX are typically identified by style (e.g., 'Heading 1', 'Heading 2'), not by position
False positive risk: If first paragraph is body text and user changes its font, evaluator passes even though no heading was changed
False negative risk: If the actual heading is not in first paragraph position, evaluator fails even if user correctly changed the heading font
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to identify paragraphs with heading styles (e.g., check if paragraph.style.name.startswith('Heading')) instead of blindly using first paragraph
Consider checking all paragraphs with heading styles, or specify which heading level (Heading 1, Heading 2, etc.) the instruction refers to
